title: 03. Functions: IMPORTANT BUILT-IN FUNCTIONS
summary: IMPORTANT BUILT-IN FUNCTIONS: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/builtins.py
# ============================================================
# ESSENTIAL BUILT-IN FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

# --- any() / all() ---
print(any([False, False, True]))   # True  (at least one truthy)
print(all([True, True, True]))     # True  (all truthy)
print(any([]))                     # False
print(all([]))                     # True  (vacuous truth!)

# Practical: Check if any user is admin
users = [{"name": "A", "admin": False}, {"name": "B", "admin": True}]
has_admin = any(u["admin"] for u in users)  # True

# --- zip() ---
names = ["Alice", "Bob"]
scores = [90, 85]
combined = dict(zip(names, scores))  # {'Alice': 90, 'Bob': 85}

# Unzip
pairs = [("a", 1), ("b", 2), ("c", 3)]
letters, numbers = zip(*pairs)  # ('a','b','c'), (1,2,3)

# --- enumerate() ---
for i, val in enumerate(["a", "b", "c"], start=1):
    print(f"{i}. {val}")

# --- sorted() with key ---
data = ["banana", "apple", "cherry"]
print(sorted(data))                       # Alphabetical
print(sorted(data, key=len))              # By length
print(sorted(data, key=lambda x: x[-1]))  # By last character

# Stable sort — preserves order of equal elements

# --- min() / max() with key ---
users = [{"name": "A", "age": 25}, {"name": "B", "age": 35}]
youngest = min(users, key=lambda u: u["age"])
oldest = max(users, key=lambda u: u["age"])

# --- isinstance() / issubclass() ---
print(isinstance(42, (int, float)))  # True (check multiple types)
print(issubclass(bool, int))         # True (bool inherits from int!)

# --- vars() / dir() ---
class Foo:
    x = 1
    y = 2

print(vars(Foo))        # {'x': 1, 'y': 2, ...} — class namespace
print(dir(Foo))         # All attributes including inherited

# --- globals() / locals() ---
x = 10
print("x" in globals())  # True

def show_locals():
    a, b = 1, 2
    print(locals())  # {'a': 1, 'b': 2}

# --- callable() ---
print(callable(print))     # True
print(callable(42))        # False
print(callable(lambda: 0)) # True

# --- exec() / eval() / compile() ---
expr = compile("2 + 3", "<string>", "eval")
print(eval(expr))  # 5

# --- repr() vs str() vs ascii() ---
s = "héllo"
print(str(s))     # héllo
print(repr(s))    # 'héllo'
print(ascii(s))   # 'h\\xe9llo'  (escapes non-ASCII)

# --- format() ---
print(format(42, "08b"))     # 00101010
print(format(3.14, ".5f"))   # 3.14000
print(format(1000, ","))     # 1,000

# --- iter() with sentinel ---
# Read lines until "STOP" is encountered
# for line in iter(input, "STOP"):
#     print(line)

# --- breakpoint() (Python 3.7+) ---
# breakpoint()  # Drops into pdb debugger
# Set PYTHONBREAKPOINT=0 to disable
```
